name: Odd one out
oneLiner: a glass grid of identical tiles (same glyph, same label) builds in and a light passes over them all; then one lifts out of the grid and flips in 3D to its other face in the accent, red or green, while the crowd falls back
say: when the speaker sets one thing apart from the rest ("everyone posts the same thing... except one", "five steps go fine and one breaks"): cut in on the crowd, the flip lands on the word that names the exception. tone red for the one that fails, green for the one that wins, accent for the brand
